a high current proton accelerator can be built using superconducting RF technology.

a high energy proton linac with a beam power of 40 MW, operated at 2.5 MHz, with a repetition rate of 100 Hz.
the design of a 1.6 MeV CW proton linac with a maximum beam power of 40 MW, and a beam current of 25 mA.
the development of high power proton linacs for the transmutation of nuclear waste.

the high current CW proton linacs are feasible and can be built with a good reliability.
a high current proton linac, operated in CW, is feasible and can be designed and built using state of the art technology.

the design of the 1.6 MeV linac has been completed and that we are now ready to start the design of a 2.5 MeV linac, to be operated at 40 mA, with a beam power of 100 MW.

the design of a 40 MW linac is possible using a single cavity design.
